purpose: Teach: スクエア/ギャル/ゲノム/クリスタル/修道/ウルトラ/ミャンマー/ヒゲ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんはスクエア型の机を使っておられたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to have a desk with square edges.
lines.style: Soft opening, like touching an old memory. Contemplative pace. Gentle smile beneath the words—not sad, but distant. Voice settles on the details, lingers slightly on 'square'.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、ギャルという言葉を初めて聞かれた時、戸惑われたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes—and you were so flustered the first time you heard the word 'gal,' weren't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm, knowing laughter woven through. Light teasing affection. Draws out the memory as if reliving his confusion. Soft emphasis on 'flustered,' then a tender tail-off on 'dear.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがゲノム研究の話されたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was younger, your father used to talk about his genome research.
lines.style: Same contemplative register. Voice steadies on 'genome'—speaking it with the quiet pride of someone who remembers him explaining it. Unhurried, precise.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、クリスタルのお皿を大切にされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you took such good care of that crystal dish he gave you, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Gentle confirmation in her voice. Not a question really—a shared knowing. Soft, deliberate pace. The word 'crystal' holds a tiny glow of memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが修道院の建築を見学されたぞ
lines.en: Gran, your father once took us to see the monastery construction when we were small.
lines.style: Voice reaches back further now, as if opening a deeper drawer. Slow, measured. A hint of wonder in the architectural detail—something grand he wanted to show.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ウルトラマンの放送をお楽しみだったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh, and how you loved watching Ultraman on the broadcast, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Playful warmth breaks through. Light, almost conspiratorial—she knows this was his simple joy. A small laugh tucked in the middle. Rises slightly on 'Ultraman,' then settles with 'dear.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがミャンマー出張に行かれたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when he was working, your father had that business trip to Myanmar.
lines.style: Voice pulls back to a professional distance for a moment—a harder memory, perhaps. Then softens again. Measured, matter-of-fact delivery, but with a subtle undercurrent of something left unsaid.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ヒゲを丁寧に整えていらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You took such care with your beard, trimming it so neatly every morning, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Softer and closer than before. Almost whispered tenderness. Lingering on the image of that small daily ritual—his hands, his care. The 'dear' carries the full weight of decades of knowing him.
